name: 10-min Chicken Cacio e Pepe
description: A Blazingly fast Cacio e Pepe with pre-cooked chicken.
instructions: Bring a small pan of well-salted water to the boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Meanwhile, finely grate the Pecorino Romano and grind plenty of black pepper into a large frying pan over medium-low heat.
Add roughly 60 ml of pasta water to the pepper and stir.
Drain the pasta, reserving plenty of pasta water, and add the spaghetti to the frying pan.
Remove the pan from the heat and gradually add the Pecorino, tossing vigorously and adding small splashes of pasta water until glossy and creamy.
Add the pre-cooked chicken and toss for 30-60 seconds until just heated through.
Finish with more black pepper and Pecorino and serve immediately.
